name: Underworld Angelic: Heretic Intimacy
source:
In the Holy Circle, all angels must identify as female. Their Holy Mother, Lady Lifeblood, has given them all the gift of life in her visage, allowing them the privilege to serve Her as Her faithful daughters. Washiel, however, one of the Circle's nurse angels, has always known himself to be male; and, he's never been able to keep this fact to himself. But, after facing years upon years of isolation and psychological torment, it seems that the Principalities in charge have finally grown tired of him. Tomorrow, Washiel shall be exiled... or, at least, that was the original plan. Now, it seems that he's to be responsible for one final patient: the illustrious Commander Gleamiel.

Commander Gleamiel, despite certainly knowing of his reputation in advance, has requested Washiel's care specifically. And, with the severity of her injuries, she'll have to stay in his ward alone with him for weeks on end. Why would someone as beloved as Commander Gleamiel, who has practically the entire Circle at her beck and call, ever stoop so low as to deliberately request Washiel's care?

Once he regains consciousness, Commander Malachi will give Washiel- or, as he'll come to know him, Cellophane- his answer.

[From [url=https://treegravy.itch.io/ua-heretic-intimacy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在“圣环”之中，所有天使都必须认同自己为女性。她们的圣母“命血圣母”依照自身的形貌赐予众天使生命的恩典，准许她们以虔诚女儿的身份侍奉左右。然而，身为圣环护士天使之一的瓦希尔，自始至终都清楚自己是男性——而且他从未将这一事实藏在心底。在承受了年复一年的孤立与精神折磨后，掌管秩序的权天使们似乎终于对他彻底失去了耐心。明天，瓦希尔便将被逐出圣环……或者说，原本的计划是这样的。如今，他似乎还得负责照料最后一名病患：声名显赫的格利米尔指挥官。

明明事先肯定早已知晓瓦希尔的名声，格利米尔指挥官却偏偏点名要由他亲自护理。由于伤势严重，她不得不独自留在瓦希尔的病房里，与他朝夕相处数周之久。像格利米尔指挥官这样备受景仰、几乎能让整个圣环随传随到的大人物，为何会自降身份，特意点名要求瓦希尔来照料自己？

一旦他恢复意识，玛拉基指挥官便会向瓦希尔——或者按照他日后对瓦希尔的称呼，“玻璃纸”——揭晓答案。

[摘自[url=https://treegravy.itch.io/ua-heretic-intimacy]itch.io[/url]]
